title: Figure 13: Modified Sänger photon positron rocket concept schematic
description: Color schematic of a spacecraft with "PAYLOAD" landers at left, "e+ TRAP BANKS" and an optional "PEC SYSTEM" in the middle, and a curved "PRESSURE PLATE" with "SOLID ABLATION MATERIAL" at right where magenta gamma-ray arrows radiate from an annihilation point and blue thrust arrows exit. Caption: "Figure 13. Modified Sänger Photon Rocket Concept (courtesy Positronics Research LLC)." Text describes Eugen Sänger's 1953 photon rocket proposal.
